lines.en: label day280:
scene hallnoonwinter
I make my way down the halls of the[school] after another uneventful day in class.
lines.zh: 又是一节平淡无奇的课结束后，我沿着[school]的走廊往前走。

lines.en: We’re beginning to near the end of the transfer process, so the halls have been a little more crowded than usual lately.
lines.zh: 转学流程快要接近尾声了，所以最近走廊比平时要拥挤一些。

lines.en: Thankfully, another janitor died during gym this afternoon, so all of the girls have been sent home early.
lines.zh: 多亏今天下午体育课上又死了一个清洁工，所有女生都被提前赶回家了。

lines.en: Or, at least they were supposed to be sent home early.
lines.zh: 或者说，至少她们本该被提前赶回家。

lines.en: I think they’re all becoming so desensitized to custodial manslaughter that they just use these happenings as excuses to increase their club time.
lines.zh: 我想她们已经对「保洁人员过失致死」这事麻木到一定程度了，干脆把这些事当成增加社团活动时间的借口。

lines.en: As such, the manga club is doing manga stuff...the soccer club is doing soccer stuff...and the going home club is doing something actually worthwhile.
lines.zh: 于是，漫画社在搞漫画那一套……足球社在搞足球那一套……而回家社则在做真正有价值的事。

lines.en: And me? I’m just...wandering the hallway, trying to figure out if there are any vending machines I may have missed when making my mental map of the[school].
lines.zh: 而我呢？我只是在……走廊里闲逛，想弄清楚我在脑子里画[school]地图时是不是漏掉了什么自动售货机。

lines.en: scene black
I find out shortly after thinking this that my mental map must be almost entirely correct as, of course, there are no additional machines anywhere.
lines.zh: 刚想到这儿我就知道了，我心里的那张地图一定基本正确，因为别处当然一台多余的机器都没有。

lines.en: Welp, there goes my fun activity for the day as I wait for Makoto to finish all of my paperwork.
lines.zh: 好吧，在我等着 Makoto 帮我处理完所有文件的时候，今天的消遣就这么没了。

lines.en: I guess I could always go check in on her and-
lines.zh: 我想我倒是可以去看看她怎么样了，然后——

lines.en: : Oh, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei！

lines.en: A-ha. Another excuse to kill time.
lines.zh: 啊哈。又是一个打发时间的借口。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall1
Thanks to Futaba, I don’t have to face the fact that I still technically have work to do and-
lines.zh: 多亏了 Futaba，我不必去面对我其实还有工作要做这个事实，然后——

lines.en: : Wait a minute, who are you?
lines.zh: : 等一下，你是谁？

lines.en: : Nodoka Nagasawa. We met once in the library and discussed Futaba’s breasts.
lines.zh: : Nodoka Nagasawa。我们在图书馆见过一次，还讨论过 Futaba 的胸部。

lines.en: : Oh, right. You’re the one who said you were into [incest].
lines.zh: : 哦，对了。你就是那个说自己喜欢[incest]的人。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall2
: That’s...not really the best thing to remember about her, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 那……实在不是关于她最值得记住的事，Sensei……

lines.en: : I disagree wholeheartedly, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 我百分之百不同意，Futaba。

lines.en: : In fact, if there is one thing worth remembering about me, it is that I accept all couples regardless of any potential stigmas surrounding them.
lines.zh: : 事实上，如果关于我有什么值得记住的事，那就是我接纳所有情侣，不管他们周围可能环绕着怎样的污名。

lines.en: : Right.
: Well, see you around I guess.
lines.zh: : 那么，回头见吧。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall3
: Wait! There’s actually a reason I stopped you.
lines.zh: : 等等！我拦下你其实是有原因的。

lines.en: : A confession of love? Let me get my notebook.
lines.zh: : 是告白吗？让我把笔记本拿出来。

lines.en: : To think you'd go so far as to wait for your best friend to be around so she can witness it...
lines.zh: : 没想到你竟然会特意等到你最好的朋友在场，好让她见证这一切……

lines.en: : Futaba, I’m touched.
lines.zh: : Futaba，我太感动了。

lines.en: : I am ready for the confession.
lines.zh: : 我已经准备好听告白了。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall4
: There is no confession! I wanted to talk to you about Nodoka moving into our class!
lines.zh: : 没有什么告白！我是想跟你谈谈 Nodoka 转到我们班的事！

lines.en: : Is that a thing that’s happening?
lines.zh: : 这是正在发生的事吗？

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall5
: Well...she’s in Miss Watabe’s class right now since I...don’t think they wanted to move anyone else into ours.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她现在在 Watabe 老师班上，因为我……觉得他们大概不想再往我们班塞人了。

lines.en: : That’s completely understandable.
lines.zh: : 这完全可以理解。

lines.en: : Are you enjoying your time with that ball of sunshine, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 你和那团阳光相处得还愉快吗，Nodoka？

lines.en: : I’m actually quite enjoying Miss Watabe’s class. I find the tightness of her skirt to be extremely alluring.
lines.zh: : 我其实挺喜欢 Watabe 老师的课的。我觉得她裙子的紧绷感极其诱人。

lines.en: : I don’t think she likes me very much, however.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得她不太喜欢我。

lines.en: : And why is that?
lines.zh: : 那是为什么？

lines.en: : Because I make her life a living hell.
lines.zh: : 因为我让她的生活变成了人间地狱。

lines.en: : Nodoka is...a little too smart for her own good.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 是……聪明得有点过头了。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s my intellect that has anything to do with it. I just really annoy her.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这和我的智力没关系。我只是真的特别烦人。

lines.en: : Wait a second...You're not the haiku girl, are you?
lines.zh: : 等一下……你不会就是那个俳句女孩吧？

lines.en: : Yes, that would be me.\nNodoka Nagasawa.\nI’m the haiku girl.
lines.zh:
: 是的，正是在下。
Nodoka Nagasawa。
我就是那个俳句女孩。

lines.en: : To be fair, I only did that for one day. But because of it, she has forever painted me as yet another “pathetic miscreant” in those beautiful, tired eyes of hers.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我只那样做过一天。可就因为那一次，在她那双美丽而疲惫的眼睛里，我被永久地归为又一个「可悲的混账」了。

lines.en: : So...if it’s okay with you, I was thinking maybe Nodoka could transfer into our class...
lines.zh: : 所以……如果你不介意的话，我在想也许可以让 Nodoka 转到我们班来……

lines.en: : It would probably help make all of us look a little better, too...
lines.zh: : 这大概也能让我们所有人看起来都体面一点……

lines.en: : What do you mean by “look a little better?” How can we not look good when I give everyone A’s in everything?
lines.zh: : 「看起来体面一点」是什么意思？我给所有人每科都打 A，我们怎么可能不体面？

lines.en: : That’s...kind of the issue.
lines.zh: : 这……恰恰就是问题所在。

lines.en: : People are starting to think that you might be taking it a little too easy on us since no one ever fails.
lines.zh: : 因为从来没人不及格，大家开始觉得你可能对我们太宽松了。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’ll just give Yumi and Maya F’s for always being mean to me.
lines.zh: : 那没问题。我就给 Yumi 和 Maya 打 F，谁让她们老是对我很刻薄。

lines.en: : That should set the record straight, right?
lines.zh: : 这样应该就能澄清事实了吧？

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall6
: Um...I don’t think that’s...a thing you should be doing...
lines.zh: : 呃……我觉得这……不是你该做的事……

lines.en: : I’m just saying that Nodoka has the highest standardized test score in Kumon-mi and that just having her around would bring our average way up.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说，Nodoka 是 Kumon-mi 标准化考试分数最高的人，光是让她在这儿就能把我们的平均分拉高很多。

lines.en: : Really? The [incest] girl has the highest standardized test score in Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那个[incest]女孩是 Kumon-mi 标准化考试分数最高的人？

lines.en: : Yes, say it loud enough for the whole[school] to hear.
lines.zh: : 对，请说得响亮一点，让整个[school]都听见。

lines.en: : Just not the test part, I’d prefer that remain low key.
lines.zh: : 不过考试那部分就算了，那个我更希望低调一点。

lines.en: : You...want me to broadcast to the entire[school] that I’m calling you the “[incest] girl?”
lines.zh: : 你……想让我向整个[school]广播，说我在叫你「[incest]女孩」？

lines.en: : That or “Futaba Fukuyama’s quirky but lovable childhood friend and future wife.”
lines.zh: : 那个，或者「Futaba Fukuyama 的古怪但可爱的青梅竹马兼未来妻子」。

lines.en: : Incest girl is much shorter. We can just go with that.
lines.zh: : [incest]女孩短多了。就用这个吧。

lines.en: : Understood. It will be a pleasure working with you from now on, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 明白了。从今往后能与你共事，是我的荣幸，Sensei。

lines.en: : I do have several conditions, however, since you'll be benefiting so much from my inclusion.
lines.zh: : 不过我有几个条件，毕竟我的加入会让你受益良多。

lines.en: : Is one of the conditions that I give you Futaba?
lines.zh: : 其中一条是要我把 Futaba 让给你吗？

lines.en: : Of course not.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。

lines.en: : You just need to let me watch when you inevitably go to town on her supple, sensual body.
lines.zh: : 你只需要让我在旁边看着——等你终究还是会在她那柔软而性感的身体上大干一场的时候。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall7
: Nodoka!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！

lines.en: : If I can’t have you, Sensei will.
lines.zh: : 如果我得不到你，Sensei 会替我得到的。

lines.en: : This seems like a good deal for me.
lines.zh: : 对我来说这交易挺划算的。

lines.en: : I shall live vicariously through him. I’m sure you understand.
lines.zh: : 我会藉由他来间接地体验。我相信你能理解。

lines.en: : I don’t!
lines.zh: : 我不理解！

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall8
: Regardless, that’s just one of several conditions. I’ll lay the rest out for you in your office tomorrow after I assemble the appropriate squadron.
lines.zh: : 无论如何，那只是几个条件之一。等我组建好合适的小队之后，明天我会在你办公室里把其余的都摊开讲给你听。

lines.en: : Squadron?...
: It’s really just one person I’m going to enlist the help of. But if we are ever going to enact change in this[school], it is something that must be done.
lines.zh: : 其实只是我要拉一个人来帮忙。不过如果我们真的要在这所[school]里推动变革，这件事就非做不可。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall9
: In the meantime, our first course of action should be informing Miss Watabe and her extremely tight skirt that she won’t need to deal with me for much longer.
lines.zh: : 与此同时，我们的首要行动应该是通知 Watabe 老师——以及她那条极紧的裙子——她不用再忍受我多久了。

lines.en: : What are you saying about my skirt, Nagasawa?
lines.zh: : 你在说我的裙子什么，Nagasawa？

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall10
: Oh, good! You’re here.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了！你在这儿。

lines.en: : She was just talking about how nicely your clothes fit you, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 她刚才只是在说你的衣服有多合身，Wakana。

lines.en: : For the last time, call me Miss Watabe around the students.
lines.zh: : 我最后说一次，在学生面前叫我 Watabe 老师。

lines.en: : Oh, gothic teacher.\nMy body craves thy soft touch.\nPlease destroy my loins.
lines.zh:
: 哦，哥特风的老师。
我身渴慕你柔软的触碰。
请来摧毁我的腰肢。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall11
: Take her.
lines.zh: : 把她带走。

lines.en: : Take me.
lines.zh: : 把我带走。

lines.en: : Fine by me. You were planning on pawning her off on me anyway, weren’t you?
lines.zh: : 我没意见。你本来就打算把她塞给我吧？

lines.en: : I was under the assumption that her behavior had improved and wasn’t going to make anything more of it.
lines.zh: : 我本来以为她的行为已经改善了，不打算再追究什么。

lines.en: : But, unlike you, I don’t enjoy the prospect of students pining after me. It clouds their judgement and makes it so I can’t instruct them properly.
lines.zh: : 不过和你不同，我并不享受学生对我朝思暮想这件事。那会蒙蔽她们的判断力，让我没法好好教她们。

lines.en: : I will do anything you say, my dearest Annabel Lee.
lines.zh: : 你让我做什么我都做，我最亲爱的 Annabel Lee。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall12
: Please put me out of my misery.
lines.zh: : 求你让我脱离苦海吧。

lines.en: : Sensei, sheathe your sword.\nPlease don't kill my one true love.\nIncest is the best.
lines.zh:
: Sensei，收剑入鞘吧。
请别杀死我唯一的真爱。
乱伦才是最棒的。

lines.en: : Where did that ending even come from?
lines.zh: : 那个结尾到底是怎么冒出来的？

lines.en: : She’s...had better...
lines.zh: : 她……写得更好过……

lines.en: : Oh, are we just ignoring her apparent affinity for [incest]?
lines.zh: : 哦，我们就这么无视她对[incest]的明显偏爱吗？

lines.en: : She is the [incest] girl, after all.
lines.zh: : 她毕竟是那个[incest]女孩啊。

lines.en: : I’m leaving.
lines.zh: : 我走了。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall13
: Wait, you can’t leave yet. You didn’t say the-
lines.zh: : 等等，你还不能走。你还没说那句——

lines.en: : I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: : Don’t we all, Miss Watabe? Don’t we all...
lines.zh: : 我们不都是这样吗，Watabe 老师？我们不都是这样……

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall14
: Well, I think that went just great. Wouldn’t you agree?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得进展相当顺利。你同意吧？

lines.en: : It went more or less how every single conversation with her goes.
lines.zh: : 大体上跟每一次和她说话的走向差不多。

lines.en: : I’m a little surprised by how open you are with teachers, though. I was thinking you were only like that with me because of things you heard from Futaba.
lines.zh: : 不过我有点惊讶你对老师也这么放得开。我原本以为你只对我这样，是因为从 Futaba 那儿听说了些什么。

lines.en: : What could I possibly gain by hiding my true self from anyone?
lines.zh: : 对任何人隐藏真实的自己，我又能得到什么？

lines.en: : You would be very surprised.
lines.zh: : 你会非常惊讶的。

lines.en: : Then educate me, Sensei. That is your job, is it not?
lines.zh: : 那就教教我吧，Sensei。那是你的工作，不是吗？

lines.en: : Should we begin our very first lesson right here in the hall?
lines.zh: : 我们要不要就在这走廊里开始我们的第一堂课？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t call it a “lesson” per se. I just think it’s a little unreasonable to rule out manipulation as a means of getting things you want from people.
lines.zh: : 我倒不会把这称作「课」。我只是觉得，把操纵当作从别人那里得到想要之物的手段而完全排除掉，有点不合理。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall15
: Oh?
: Do you...often do things like that, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你……经常做那种事吗，Sensei？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 是的。

lines.en: : Not often, but I think everyone manipulates people from time to time.
lines.zh: : 不常做，不过我觉得每个人都会时不时地操纵别人。

lines.en: : Whether it be pretending to remember a family member you see at a gathering after many years apart or just...
lines.zh: : 比如在多年未见之后，在聚会上假装还记得某个亲戚；或者只是……

lines.en: : Something simpler. Like threatening to talk to someone’s manager to get a discount on something.
lines.zh: : 更简单一点的事。比如威胁要去找某人的经理投诉，好拿到折扣。

lines.en: : Manipulation is a way of life.
lines.zh: : 操纵是一种生活方式。

lines.en: : So when Nodoka says things like “What can I gain from hiding my true self?” the logical answer is “A lot.”
lines.zh: : 所以当 Nodoka 说出「隐藏真实的自己能得到什么」这种话时，合乎逻辑的答案就是「很多」。

lines.en: : I like you.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你。

lines.en: : You’re no Miss Watabe, but I definitely like you.
lines.zh: : 你比不上 Watabe 老师，但我确实喜欢你。

lines.en: : Thanks. I figured things could go either way after saying that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我说完那番话之后就猜到结果可能有两种走向。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall16
: Didn’t I tell you that you and Sensei would get along? You two have a lot in common.
lines.zh: : 我不是说过你和 Sensei 会合得来吗？你们俩有很多共同点。

lines.en: : Just having things in common isn’t enough to get along. But yes, I can see what it is that you see in him.
lines.zh: : 光有共同点并不足以合得来。不过没错，我能看出你看中他哪一点了。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall17
: That tangent of yours does call into question whether or not you’ve been manipulating my darling Futaba this whole time, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你那番话也让人怀疑，你是不是一直都在操纵我亲爱的 Futaba。

lines.en: : And perhaps your talk on manipulation itself was an attempt to manipulate me into thinking you are more than just the average teacher.
lines.zh: : 也许你那番关于操纵的言论本身，就是一种操纵，想让我以为你不只是个普通的老师。

lines.en: : You’ve given me much to think about in such a short amount of time. This is good.
lines.zh: : 你在这么短的时间里给了我这么多可思考的东西。这很好。

lines.en: : Well I...can’t say for certain, but I don’t think Sensei would ever do something like that to any of the girls in class.
lines.zh: : 嗯我……不敢肯定，但我觉得 Sensei 绝不会对班上任何一个女生做那种事。

lines.en: : He genuinely cares about all of us.
lines.zh: : 他是真心关心我们所有人的。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall18
: He just shows it in...different ways sometimes.
lines.zh: : 他只是有时候表达的方式……比较特别。

lines.en: : Yes. Inject that cuteness directly into my veins, Futaba. Feed me more of your adorable, innocent blushing until I can consume no more.
lines.zh: : 没错。把那份可爱直接注射进我的血管里吧，Futaba。再多喂我一点你那惹人怜爱、天真无邪的脸红，直到我再也无法消受。

lines.en: : Come! Let us tear each other’s clothes off in the science lab and compare how much we have grown!
lines.zh: : 来吧！让我们在实验室里剥光彼此的衣服，比比看我们长了多少！

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall19
: How many times do you need to compare that?!
lines.zh: : 那个你到底要比较多少次啊？！

lines.en: : As many as it takes.
lines.zh: : 需要多少次就多少次。

lines.en: : You two are...really close, huh?
lines.zh: : 你们俩……关系真好啊？

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall20
: As close as Miss Watabe’s skirt is to those shapely, pale thighs of hers.
lines.zh: : 就像 Watabe 老师的裙子紧贴着她那双匀称而苍白的大腿一样。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say that close, but yes. We’re very good friends, whether Nodoka constantly jokes about being more or not.
lines.zh: : 我不会说有那么亲密，不过是的。我们是非常好的朋友，不管 Nodoka 是不是总开玩笑说要更进一步。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall21
: To have one’s love dismissed as mere joking after all these years...how utterly heartbreaking.
lines.zh: : 这么多年过去，自己的爱意却被当成玩笑一笑置之……真是令人肝肠寸断。

lines.en: : Things will get better, Nodoka. Pretty soon, you’ll be able to tease Futaba for almost seven hours a day.
lines.zh: : 情况会好起来的，Nodoka。很快，你每天就能有将近七个小时可以逗 Futaba 了。

lines.en: : And in front of an audience.
lines.zh: : 而且还当着观众的面。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall22
: Don’t encourage her!
lines.zh: : 别鼓励她啊！

lines.en: : You’re right! I didn’t even think of things that way!
lines.zh: : 你说得对！我怎么就没想到这一层！

lines.en: : The prospect of getting to spend more time with Futaba was enticing enough, but watching her face grow bright red as I embarrass her in front of her peers?
lines.zh: : 光是能和 Futaba 待更久就已经够诱人了，更别说看着她在我当着同学的面让她难堪时整张脸涨得通红？

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’ve ever been this excited before.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己以前有没有这么兴奋过。

lines.en: Well, it will certainly be interesting having a resident Futaba hype-man around to counteract all of the horrible things Yumi is constantly throwing at her.
lines.zh: 嗯，身边常驻一个 Futaba 的头号吹鼓手，来抵消 Yumi 不停朝她扔的那些可怕玩意儿，肯定会很有意思。

lines.en: Whenever she actually shows up, that is.
lines.zh: 当然，是在 Yumi 真的出现的时候。

lines.en: But apart from this, I feel like there are a few other things Nodoka can bring to the table as well.
lines.zh: 不过除此之外，我觉得 Nodoka 还能带来一些别的东西。

lines.en: Because not only is she apparently smart enough to somehow dispel suspicions about my class having it easy by just being there-
lines.zh: 因为她不仅显然足够聪明，光是人在那儿就能打消「我这个班过得很轻松」的怀疑——

lines.en: But she is openly a gigantic pervert.
lines.zh: 而且她还公然是个大变态。

lines.en: And cute.
lines.zh: 而且还很可爱。

lines.en: Everyone wins and today is a good day.
lines.zh: 所有人都赢了，今天是个好日子。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall23
: So, how does Thursday sound for an introduction?
lines.zh: : 那么，星期四做自我介绍怎么样？

lines.en: : I’m sure the transfer will process by then, but I don’t want to formally introduce myself to everyone until our mission is complete.
lines.zh: : 转学手续到时候肯定办好了，不过在任务完成之前，我还不想正式向大家做自我介绍。

lines.en: : Mission? Are you talking about that thing you need a squadron for?
lines.zh: : 任务？你说的是需要小队去做的那件事吗？

lines.en: : Precisely. But, like I said, I’ll provide more details tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 正是。不过就像我说的，明天我会讲更多细节。

lines.en: : For now, my good friend and future wife
lines.zh: : 至于现在，我的好朋友兼未来妻子

lines.en: : I’d normally be fine with inviting you, but I’d feel horrible if you wound up being a third wheel.
lines.zh: : 我平时是很乐意邀请你的，可如果你最后只能当个电灯泡，我会很难受。

lines.en: : At this rate, I feel like I’ll wind up becoming the third wheel.
lines.zh: : 照这个势头下去，我觉得最后变成电灯泡的人会是我。

lines.en: : That’s not true. Nodoka clearly has her sights set on you, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 才不会。Nodoka 明显是盯上你了，Futaba。

lines.en: : And Miss Watabe’s skirt. Don’t forget about Miss Watabe’s skirt.
lines.zh: : 还有 Watabe 老师的裙子。别忘了 Watabe 老师的裙子。

lines.en: scene nodokafutabahall24
: God I want her to tie me up and throw me in a closet and just never come back.
lines.zh: : 天啊，我真想让她把我绑起来扔进柜子里，然后永远都别回来。

lines.en: scene black
Same.
lines.zh: 同上。

lines.en: I would like if she were to come back, but that might just be me.
lines.zh: 我还是希望她能回来的，不过这可能只是我个人的想法。

lines.en: Either way, the three of us wind up parting ways and, after a brief reunion with Makoto about this final transfer from Miss Watabe’s class, I start heading home.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们三个最终还是分道扬镳；而我和 Makoto 就这最后一桩从 Watabe 老师班上调走的事简短地碰了个头之后，我便动身回家了。

lines.en: I can’t help but wonder what this mission I’m going to hear about tomorrow is, though...
lines.zh: 不过我忍不住好奇，明天要听到的那个任务到底是什么……

$ nodoka_love += 1
Nodoka’s affection has increased to [nodoka_love]!
lines.zh: Nodoka 的好感度提升到了 [nodoka_love]！
